title.rendered: Pop Can Fundraiser  – Help Us Help Others

content.rendered: Mrs. Conrad’s 4th grade class is doing a fundraiser to purchase supplies for Paradise Elementary School in California that was destroyed by the Camp Fire in November.  Her class will be collecting clean cans and bottles first thing each morning from January 7th – 11th.  Drop-off is at the entrance to the gym and cafeteria.  If you’d rather donate money to the cause, you can write a check to Middleton Elementary with a subject of “Paradise Elementary” or give a cash donation in the school office.  Thank you for supporting our service learning project!
